title: Carnival Liberty | Day 4- Montego Bay cruise port, Jamaica | Doctor’s cave beach 02/19/25 🚢
description:
This is the Day 4 video from our sailing on Carnival Liberty from New Orleans, LA from February 16-23, 2025. We really enjoyed Montego Bay, Jamaica cruise port!  Doctor’s cave beach was absolutely beautiful! The people were SO friendly and kind! We cannot wait to go back!

This cruise was focused on our children and their experience on Carnival Liberty. The adult only experience version can be found in our previous vlog 2 weeks ago. The link for it is below. 

Follow us on this video as we explore this wonderful ship!
